title: The Almost Christian
edition: Preached at Saint Mary's, Oxford, 25 July 1741. The panel is the 1771 Works.
blurb: Rendered in modern English, to be read and heard. Open the 1771 text under each part to check the claims and the scripture.
era_note: John Wesley lived from 1703 to 1791. This sermon was preached in 1741. It is an English sermon, not an ante-Nicene father.

text_history.method: Rendered in modern English. The 1771 panel is the text of the Works Wesley himself had printed in 1771. It is public domain.
text_history.identifiers: Sermon 2 in the 1771 Works. Saint Mary's, Oxford, 25 July 1741. Acts 26:28.
